data.name: label4.Text
data.value: Software Install hone ke Baaad Ek Baar IP Block Check Karna Jaroori Hai, Achche Result ke liye Aapko Local System Istemal Karna ahi, VPS PE IP Block ka isse jyada aata hai, Booking se pahle aapko apna mobile ek baar Flight mode daalke wapas net Connet karna hai, agar broad abad use kar rahe hain to router ko 2 minut ke liye band karke wapas chaalu karna hai
